meta.name: Engineering Girls
meta.description: Experience the life of girls in an engineering college with Maggu, Sabu, and Kiara.

videos.title: Practical File
videos.overview: Maggu has her final practical today and her file is missing. Sabu is preparing to complete a risky challenge and Kiara is fighting for her place in the drama society. What will these girls do to solve their problems?

videos.title: Ghar Ke Laddu
videos.overview: Maggu has her important exam tomorrow and Sabu brings her home-made Laddus. Somehow things heat up and they end up having a fight. Kiara is trying to sort their issues. Maggu falls into deeper trouble.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: Maggu and Kiara forget Sabu's Birthday. On the other hand, Sabu's startup plan is on stake.

videos.title: The Mistake
videos.overview: Sabu misses an important deadline. Maggu is worried about her Internship and Kiara goes back to Uday. The 3 crazy girls are forced to do something really wrong.

videos.title: Awaazein
videos.overview: Will Kiara get to perform in chorus ? Will Sabu get into Startup conclave ? And what will happen to Maggu?

videos.title: C2H6O
videos.overview: Bored of their mundane lives, the girls plan a drinking party in the hostel. It turns out to be one eventful night with Maggu preparing drinks in the chemistry lab.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: After the epic party night, Maggu goes missing, and her mother calls Sabu to enquire about her. Everyone panics and starts looking around for Maggu, while her mother keeps waiting outside the PTM room.

videos.title: Engineering is Tough, Life is Tougher
videos.overview: The girls' lives turn upside down as uncertainties keep popping up, only to reveal some ugly truths about their friendship and their relationship with themselves.

videos.title: Perfectly Placed
videos.overview: It’s the biggest day of their college lives and the last fest of the girls together. Things don’t go as planned, but what happens instead is nothing less than perfect.

videos.title: Bonus Episode: Engineering Ka Bhoot
videos.overview: A spirit enters the hostel and disrupts the students’ day-to-day activities. Things get interesting when Kiara is suspected to be the one behind the ghostly occurrences.
